title: Explainability & Interpretability — Ask Why the Model Chose This
key_insight: Explainability methods provide evidence about inputs, examples, or internal behavior that influenced an output.
body:
## Ask Why the Model Chose This

A loan applicant receives a rejection with no usable reason. A prediction without context cannot be checked or challenged.

Explainability methods provide evidence about inputs, examples, or internal behavior that influenced an output.

An explanation is a model of the model, not automatic truth. Pair it with performance checks and a real appeal path.
common_mistakes: A colorful heatmap is always faithful.
One local explanation describes all global behavior.
Explainability removes the need for appeals.
mini_exercise: Draw “Ask Why the Model Chose This” as three steps and explain each one.
real_world_usage: Explanations can help people inspect model behavior, but they must be tested rather than mistaken for proof.
explain_back_prompt: Use “Ask Why the Model Chose This” to explain Explainability & Interpretability plainly.
